Boox Portable Bluetooth Speaker| Eco-Friendly

Features

Immersive Sound Experience: Immerse yourself in crystal-clear sound with our Boox Portable Bluetooth speaker. Equipped with a 5W speaker output and a built-in bass radiator, experience dynamic audio with superb bass that brings your music to life.
Rugged and Waterproof: Designed to accompany you on all your adventures, the Sound Crush Boox is built to withstand the elements. Its waterproof construction ensures that your music never stops, no matter where your journey takes you.
Wireless Charging and TWS: Experience convenience like never before with 15W wireless charging capability. Additionally, True Wireless Stereo (TWS) technology allows you to pair two units together for an incredible stereo output of up to 10W, filling your space with rich, balanced sound.
Versatile Compatibility: The Boox speaker is compatible with a wide range of devices and power adapters, including PD, QC, and 5V-12V adapters (not included). Whether you’re using it at home or on the go, rest assured that it seamlessly integrates with your existing setup.
Long-lasting Battery Life: : With an 1800mAh rechargeable battery, enjoy up to 8 hours of continuous playtime on a single charge. When it’s time to recharge, simply connect via the Type-C port for fast and efficient charging.

Sustainable Materials

At the heart of eco-friendly portable speakers lies a commitment to sustainable materials. Manufacturers are increasingly opting for recycled or renewable resources in the construction of speaker components. From bamboo and cork to recycled plastics and aluminium, these materials offer a blend of durability, aesthetics, and eco-friendliness.
